consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1992-03-20 show at Copps Coliseum was a standout performance, particularly praising the energy and musicianship throughout the second set. Highlights include a captivating 'Dark Star' and an exceptional 'Shakedown Street', making it one of the best shows of the year.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 51 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm for the performance, especially the second set, significantly elevates the sentiment beyond neutral.
